transcript.text: Back in Chengdu, I remember we kept talking about how many places there were to eat—felt like the whole city was one giant food map.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Then when I was staying in Suzhou for a bit, the whole home-services thing came up all the time in our building chat—everyone had some recommendation.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Funny enough, that same Chengdu trip also had us comparing rental cars—people kept bringing up different models and where they picked them up.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: One meal that really stuck with me was Lao Ma Tou Hotpot—Wu Qian had set it up for 4 of us, and it was on 2025-03-10.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I still remember the details because we showed up right at 11:30, and the contact number on it was 13833445566.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Suzhou, my neighbor had a home service appointment already done on 2025-03-14 in the afternoon, at Room 1208, Block D, Sunshine Plaza.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And she joked she kept the confirmation screenshot because the phone on it was 13822334455—separately, He Xia had rented a Nissan Sylphy starting 2025-05-21 for 2 days.
